examples.label: Example 1
examples.input:
10
new
add car 5
add card 3
add care 5
add cat 1
suggest ca
add cat 9
suggest ca
suggest card
suggest d
examples.expected: null null null null null ["car", "care", "card"] null ["cat", "car", "care"] ["card"] []
examples.display:
calls   = Autocomplete(), add(car, 5), add(card, 3),
          add(care, 5), add(cat, 1), suggest(ca), add(cat, 9),
          suggest(ca), suggest(card), suggest(d)
results = null, null, null, null, null,
          ["car", "care", "card"], null,
          ["cat", "car", "care"], ["card"], []

"car" and "care" tie on 5, so "car" is first. After "cat" rises to 10 it takes the lead and "card" drops off the list of three.
